system.description: You burn sacred incense and inhale deeply.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts until your next Long Rest.
outcomes.success: For 1 hour, you can speak with and understand any sentient creature as your souls commune.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and incense are lost.
outcomes.ruin: Your souls commune too well: you speak only in the creature's tongue for 1 hour. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
